sign_orbit_adapter.use: Avoid duplicate diagnostic arithmetic on Q-isomorphic sign partners only; no authoritative branch-transfer credit is claimed before hostile audit.

prior_chabauty_resource_wall.result: Direct Points(J : Bound:=10000) did not produce a non-torsion point before external timeout/resource termination; this is no mathematical failure.

logic: Recompute the unconditional exact RankBound(J) and require it <=1.
Call MordellWeilGroupGenus2 with the already-proved upper bound one. RankOnly skips saturation and returns as soon as rank is determined.
If the returned abstract group has a free generator, map it to J(Q); this gives a certified non-torsion point while rank<=1 forces rank exactly one.
Run Chabauty on that non-torsion point. Chabauty internally works with the saturation of the generated subgroup, so the point need not be primitive.
Exhaustively exact-test all returned C(Q) points against U,V,A,B degeneracy and the four parent square conditions.

credit: Diagnostic only. Failure to find a free generator within these effort bounds is a resource/search wall, not rank zero. Any complete Chabauty candidate still requires a separate proof replay and hostile-audit promotion before branch closure/transfer.
